accent.justification: A muted violet (#8184C4) was chosen over cool gray to provide a distinctive, professional software feel that maps perfectly to the Linear aesthetic while remaining sufficiently subdued and avoiding forbidden hex codes.

radius.policy: Maximum 6px. ALL pills (rounded-full), rounded-lg, rounded-xl, etc., must be eliminated and replaced with 4px or 6px radii across the entire app.

shadows_and_gradients.policy: NO shadows, NO gradients, NO glows, NO film-grain on body. Remove all drop-shadow and box-shadow utilities. Depth is achieved ONLY via hairline borders and flat background colors.
shadows_and_gradients.elevation_replacement: Instead of elevation tokens (--elev-*), use: border border-white/10 bg-[#181818]

buttons.secondary: bg-[#222222] text-[#F4F4F5] hover:bg-[#2C2C2C] rounded-sm px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium border border-white/10 transition-colors duration-100 ease-in
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-[#F4F4F5] hover:bg-white/5 rounded-sm px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in

marketing_landing.hero: Solid #111111 background. NO gradient meshes or glows. Use a subtle hairline grid pattern (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) for texture. Typography must be extremely sharp. Use muted violet (#8184C4) exclusively for primary CTAs and key highlights.
marketing_landing.sections: Flat surfaces separated by hairline borders. Feature cards should follow the exact same component styling as the app (flat, 6px radius, hairline borders).
marketing_landing.motion: Immediate and precise. Use framer-motion for slight fade-ups (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> 1) but keep durations very short (0.2s).

motion_policy.easings: ease-out for entering, ease-in for exiting. Avoid bouncy spring physics.

migration_plan.step_1: CSS Tokens (index.css): Update --bg (#111111), --surface (#181818), --surface-2 (#222222), --accent (#8184C4). Remove --elev-* tokens. Modify --hairline to rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Remove any gradient or noise/film-grain tokens applied to body.
migration_plan.step_2: Global Radius & Shadows: Run a project-wide search-and-replace in .js files to change 'rounded-full', 'rounded-lg', 'rounded-xl', 'rounded-2xl' to 'rounded-md' (6px) or 'rounded-sm' (4px). Remove all 'shadow-sm', 'shadow-md', 'shadow-lg', 'shadow-xl', 'drop-shadow-*' classes.
migration_plan.step_3: Typography & Spacing: Apply tight tracking to all H1/H2 headings. Update Data Table components to enforce the 32px/44px row heights. Refactor Boxed Tabs (.memory-tabs, .memory-tab).
migration_plan.step_4: Component Fixes: Apply the exact flex-col structure fix to Connect Work Provider Cards to eliminate the Disconnect CTA overlap with the status chip.
migration_plan.step_5: Marketing Alignment: Strip gradients, background glows, and large radii from the marketing/landing page. Ensure it matches the same strict dark flat system.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
No generic centered layouts. Use left-aligned, information-dense layouts.
DO NOT use gradients or shadows. Depth comes exclusively from hairline borders (1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) and flat surface color steps.
Maximum border-radius across the entire application is 6px (rounded-md). Replace all pills/rounded-full elements.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them. Ensure sufficient contrast with backdrop blurs and base opacity fills.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='provider-card-disconnect').
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons exclusively.
Keep spacing extremely tight and exact, matching the 'Linear' aesthetic. Data tables should feel highly technical and dense.
Always apply hover, active, and focus states explicitly. Do not rely on universal 'transition: all', use specific transition properties to avoid breaking transforms.
Applies exclusively to .js and .jsx files as requested by the user, not .tsx files.
